note: v4.24 CRA-anchored R7 methodology upgrade, realised. TWO corrections land under this version. (1) R7_cyber v1 (DESI/ACN documented-proxy) hard cutover to R7_cyber_v2 (CRA Article 14 + NIS2 Article 21 register-anchored Path C+D composite, w_entity=0.55 / w_product=0.45, envelope [0.99, 1.05]). v1 tombstoned and EXCLUDED from the multiplicative product by compute_modifier_terms; _r7_cyber_v1_value snapshot retained per Convention #56. At v0 the product layer is unpopulated cohort-wide, so the composite runs entity-only with the product weight redistributed - disclosed, not defaulted. (2) M-006: soft_clip_upper corrected from a logistic form that was discontinuous at R=1.0 (a 0.731 drop) and inverted the ranking above the threshold, to min(R, 1.0). Saturating the multiplicative chain at 1.0 restores continuity and monotonicity and yields max R_final = 1.30, the band ceiling. Approximately 1.5% of substations move up one or more bands as a result; Extreme grows. Cohort: 718,436 substations across 39 countries.
